reason_for_version: V4 applied a q >= 0.5 route-support threshold only to P1. V5 removes availability from route eligibility. Every arm receives the same geometry-generated candidates and the same static-body, swept-rollout and terminal-goal feasibility decisions. Forecasts may change objective values only.
purpose: Choose deterministic routes before stochastic execution from an identical feasible candidate set in every planner condition.
evidence_role: The bound P0/P1 fields exercise the repaired selector only. Final four-arm routes must be regenerated from the selected Bernoulli-GP availability artifact and matched covariance forecasts; this protocol does not authorize the final campaign.

P0.meaning: constant future-availability control used in route cost only

P1.meaning: commissioned future availability used in route cost only

nominal_route_prior.rationale: Fixed route-design prior shared by all arms; not estimated from final-audit or runtime outcomes.

candidate_generation: Generate one deterministic set per task from lane-graph polylines, vertical traversable-rectangle centrelines, endpoint-lane variants, and combined start-and-goal lane-centre variants. Generation reads only the registered driveable-region union.

common_feasibility.definition: A candidate is feasible only when the static rectangular body clears the map, the runtime bounded-unicycle swept rectangular footprint is valid, and the rollout ends within the common terminal tolerance. The selector fails if any arm assigns a different feasibility result.

selection_rule: For each task, generate one candidate set and establish one common feasible subset using geometry, swept-body rollout and terminal-goal reachability only. Evaluate the objective of every common feasible candidate under each arm's future observation model. Select the minimum-cost candidate per arm, using candidate name only as an exact-cost tie break.
availability_role: q_sensor changes expected future information and route cost only. No q threshold, support classifier or availability statistic may generate, remove or legalize a route.
execution_design: Hash-bind each selected route after selection. Matched stochastic seeds execute the routes without running the global optimizer during a replicate.
final_audit_firewall: Final-audit labels, residuals and outcomes do not enter candidate generation, feasibility, route scoring or route selection.
